description: Draft a reviewable converter spec for a loaded document, usually after inspect shows its tables. This does not convert anything: pass the spec to convert, inline or as the file you saved. Save it to outPath for human editing, or omit outPath to return the JSON under the response cap; an existing outPath is refused unless overwrite=true. format picks one .xlsx workbook or a .zip of CSVs; baseDate gives time-only columns a date.

baseDate.description: Optional yyyy-MM-dd or today for time-only columns.

outPath.description: Optional path for the drafted .json spec.

overwrite.description: Replace outPath only when explicitly true.

name: draft_spec
